sd_guide_s1_c4_desc: Enable Windows Developer Mode or run Sanctuary OS as Administrator so the Airgap engine can project zero-byte symlinks instead of falling back to hardlinks.
sd_guide_s1_tip: Click the Cloud Auto-Detect icon during setup to automatically locate your Game Bin and Mods directories for the active workspace.
sd_guide_s2_desc: Your high-level glassmorphic mission control. Monitors the health of your active Blueprint, surfaces creator updates and system dispatches, and provides 1-click access to Radar Sweeps and Vault Lockdown.
sd_guide_s2_c1_desc: All equipped artifacts match your active game version, all required DLCs and dependencies are satisfied, and zero unmitigated collisions exist.
sd_guide_s2_c2_desc: Newer SHA-256 versions have been detected either via the Spoke Cloud Registry or decentralized creator manifest.json endpoints.

sd_guide_s2_c4_desc: An equipped artifact is Corrupted, incompatible with your Game Patch, missing a mandatory dependency/DLC, or locked in a Severity 4 Fatal Clash.
sd_guide_s2_tip: Use the global SystemStatusBar at the bottom of the window to trigger a Radar Sweep or instant Vault Lockdown from any screen in the OS.
sd_guide_s3_desc: Your local library and secured asset bunker. The game engine never touches your Vault directly—files are ingested, hashed via SHA-256, sanitized, and projected via symlinks.
sd_guide_s3_c1_desc: Drag and drop .package, .ts4script, .zip, .rar, .7z, .tar.zst, or override.json files anywhere into Sanctuary OS. Duplicate SHA-256 hashes are automatically intercepted.
sd_guide_s3_c2_desc: When a mod archive includes a creator's override.json, Sanctuary binds its SHA-256 lineage to the creator's static manifest.json URL for serverless update alerts and atomic rules.
sd_guide_s3_c3_desc: Removing a core master library (such as XML Injector) automatically alerts you and queues all dependent add-ons so your loadout never breaks.
sd_guide_s3_c4_desc: Incompatible or broken mods automatically enter a translucent Ghosted state with hover tooltips detailing Missing DLC, Version Mismatches, or Collisions.

sd_guide_s6_title: Conflict Radar & Schema Load Order Engine
sd_guide_s6_desc: Sanctuary combines global Architect Directives, creator Static Edge rules, and a topological Load Order compiler to resolve tuning overlaps and prevent crashes before launch.
sd_guide_s6_c1_desc: For Severity 3 Tuning Overlaps, simply click the mod you want to win. Sanctuary automatically compiles the priority rules and routes the winner into the top override tier.
sd_guide_s6_c2_title: Advanced Mode: Directional Rules & Cycle Breaker
sd_guide_s6_c2_desc: Author custom 'Must Load After / Before' rules, assign explicit Priority Tiers (Base to Sanctuary3), and resolve circular dependency loops with 1-click Break Loop.
sd_guide_s6_c3_desc: Severity 4 indicates a hard binary/script clash where only one mod can remain enabled. Severity 3 indicates a tuning overlap solvable via Load Order priority.

sd_fork_standalone_hero_desc: Want to run your own completely independent build of Sanctuary OS—or transition an existing Spoke after clicking Cut the Cord? You only need a single Supabase database (schema.sql) and a 1-file edit in src/supabase.ts. Zero Edge Functions required.
sd_fork_standalone_s1_desc: When mode is set to 'standalone', Sanctuary OS automatically routes all 15 secure_* RPCs directly against your single Supabase database with zero Edge Function dependency.
sd_fork_standalone_s2_desc: The on_auth_user_created_spoke trigger in schema.sql detects when your standalone database has 0 Wayfinders and automatically promotes the very first registered user to Founding Wayfinder.
sd_fork_standalone_s3_desc: All internal queries to global broadcasts, polls, and support categories automatically map to your single database's system_broadcasts, dispatch_poll_votes, and support_tickets tables.
sd_fork_schema_hero_title: Dynamic Game Schemas & 'Cut the Cord' Severance
sd_fork_schema_hero_desc: Sanctuary OS never hardcodes game paths or file extensions in Rust. Every game ecosystem is defined by a declarative JSON schema—and every community holds an unconditional right to Cut the Cord.
sd_fork_cord_community_desc: A Wayfinder can double-click 'Cut the Cord' in Wayfinder Hub -> Spoke Uplink & Sovereignty at any time.
